caption: The image displays a decorative plate with a central illustration and an ornate border. The primary color scheme appears to be grayscale, suggesting the image is either in black and white or a monochrome photograph. In the center of the plate, there is a detailed drawing of a large, multi-storied building with a classical architectural style, including columns at the entrance, multiple chimneys, and several windows. The building is situated on raised ground with a staircase leading down to a fenced lower area. In the foreground, a small figure stands on the staircase. To the right of the building, there are trees, and above, clouds fill the sky. Surrounding this central scene, the rim of the plate is decorated with a repeating pattern of large flowers and leaves, bordered by smaller geometric designs. The floral elements are distributed evenly around the edge and appear to be rendered with intricate linework, filling the entire border of the plate.
title: Plate - "Insane Hospital, Boston"
